The '''1994 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 50th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Each team played 22 games with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. This year was the last consisting of 12 teams. The format was expanded to 14 teams the following year. Because of this, number eleven and twelve were relegated, while the winners and runners-up of the two groups of the [[Adeccoligaen|first division]] were promoted.

==Promotion and relegation==
*[[Strindheim Fotball|Strindheim]], [[IL Hødd|Hødd]], [[Molde FK|Molde]] and [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] were promoted.
*[[Sogndal Fotball|Sogndal]] and [[Strømsgodset Toppfotball|Strømsgodset]] were relegated.
*Because of the format-expansion, no play-offs were played this year.
